legend: The Rougarou (Louisiana bayou, Cajun swamp werewolf legend)
lines: Deep in the Louisiana swamps, the Cajuns whisper about the rougarou.
They say it is a man cursed to become a beast with a wolf's head.
Legend says the curse falls on anyone who skips Lent for seven years.
On foggy nights, a lantern swings along the bayou path.
Something big follows, and glowing eyes shine between the cypress trees.
Grandparents warn that it chases anyone who is out too late.
They say thirteen coins at your door make it count until sunrise.
At sunrise, the beast is gone.
Is it just a swamp story? What do you think?
title: The Rougarou: The Swamp Beast That Must Count Your Coins #shorts
description:
In the Louisiana bayou, Cajuns tell of the rougarou, a cursed man with a wolf's head who hunts on foggy nights. They say thirteen coins at your door can stop it.
